text_block_list.text: I escort Seiun Sky to the infirmary after she suffers an injury while training.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's not a big deal, sheesh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: An injury like this is nothing to sweat over. It'll heal right up with just a bandage or something.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But if you're so worried, maybe we ought to call off the rest of today's training, huh?
choice_data_list: Let's take it easy for a while!
If your injury's as small as you say, why not continue?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What? I mean, you can tell me to sit still, but…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You're asking for a lot trying to pin me down in one spot, y'know? I'm like a cloud, I go wherever the wind blows.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what do you think we should do?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, I've got it. If I have to behave myself, then you have to take care of me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'll be expecting flawless bedside manner from you till I'm back in shipshape. ♪
Agreeing to Seiun Sky's various self-serving terms, I nurse her back to health.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wow, you're not worried about my well-being…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You got me. I did say the injury wasn't bad enough to warrant needing rest.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But I'll be in serious trouble if training makes it worse…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Don't you think you should just trust me, and let me do what I want?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Well, I don't like being forced to stay put, and there's no way I'm gonna waste this incredible opportunity to slack off.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Running Late
text_block_list.text: Oh man! I'm gonna be late for practice! Outta my waaay!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Gyaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Owww! Urgh, I think my injury just got worse!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Don't you think you should just trust me, and let me do what I want?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I did wangle my way out of that conversation with Trainer pretty smoothly…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But no one knows my body better than me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep, doing what I want, when I want like always is definitely gonna be the shortest path to recovery.
Seiun Sky's relaxed recovery restores her to good health before long, and she's soon back to training again.
